entries.reason: Accept the complete checkbox label „Dithering boja“ as a concise technical borrowing qualified by Croatian genitive plural boja. It names colour dithering instead of blurring and is suitable as a noun-phrase option label. It does not imply applying blur, animation, transparency or a different algorithm. The paired explanation supplies its purpose. No better fully localized technical label is established by the available evidence, so none is invented.

confidence.scope: Croatian technical UI wording and source-static semantics; intelligible borrowing, not certification of preferred native terminology

qualifications: Dithering remains an English technical loanword. This acceptance does not claim it is the uniquely standard Croatian term or that every novice will recognize it without the adjacent explanation.
The initial checked state comes from initial.dither, whose type default is true; it is not unconditionally enabled. Changing the label does not change the option state or encoder behavior.

entries.source: Still image, up to 256 colours. Dithering smooths colour gradients. Animated GIFs open as their first frame.

Removing only the obsolete Zamućivanje-label parenthetical is correct once the checkbox label changes atomically; it removes misleading legacy guidance without weakening the format or animation-loss statements.

ditherBox is VISIBLE only for GIF and GONE otherwise. GIF selects save20_gif_description; the explanation is not conditional on ditherBox.isChecked.

Confirmation passes the actual ditherBox.isChecked Boolean into ExportOptions. The label is presentation text, not a mode identifier or implementation flag.

The BMP/GIF dispatch forwards options.dither and a separate GIF Boolean to BitmapFileCodec. This verifies option forwarding, not the codec implementation; no downstream algorithm behavior beyond the included source is certified.
